name: Mishael
overview: Mishael is a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified uniquely as the son of Uzziel. His lineage situates him within the Levitical family, which is significant for its priestly and service roles in Israel. Beyond his paternal connection, Scripture does not provide further details about his life or activities.
namesAndTitles: The name Mishael means 'Who belongs to G-d [El]?' This proper name reflects a relationship or belonging to God, emphasizing a theocentric identity consistent with Levitical heritage. The name is recorded in Exodus 6:22.
familyAndRelationships: Mishael is explicitly identified as the son of Uzziel, establishing his place within the Levitical genealogy. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Mishael's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Levi as the son of Uzziel, as noted in Exodus 6:22. This connection identifies him as part of the Levitical lineage that God appointed for service and priestly duties among the Israelites. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal deeds, his inclusion in the genealogical record underscores the faithfulness of God's covenant people and the continuity of His appointed servants.
